name: @w6w-apps/checkly
description: Run and inspect Checkly synthetic monitors, their results, alerts and maintenance windows.

w6w.longDescription:
Checkly runs synthetic monitors — scripted checks that hit an API or browse a page on a schedule — and this app puts the results of that monitoring into a workflow. List and inspect checks and the groups they belong to, trigger an ad-hoc run, and read back results, current status and the alerts Checkly actually sent.

Beyond the read path, it can activate, deactivate or mute a check, open and close maintenance windows to silence monitoring during a planned deploy, and manage the environment variables a check's script depends on. Reporting and account-entitlement actions round out the picture for a workflow that needs to know what the current plan allows.

The distinctions matter here: a muted check keeps recording without paging anyone, a deactivated one stops recording entirely, and a triggered run reports only that it started, not whether it passed. This app surfaces those states the way Checkly itself defines them rather than collapsing everything into a single pass-or-fail signal.
